definition.description: Global collection of aggregated player statistics. Each document represents a single player and contains their consolidated stats from all processed matches.

firestore.reasoning: This structure is designed for an efficient data aggregation pipeline. Raw match data is ingested into the `rawMatchResults` collection, which acts as a queue. A Cloud Function, triggered by document creation in this collection, processes each match. It aggregates player statistics and updates the corresponding documents in the `playerAggregates` collection. Using a separate, global collection for `playerAggregates` is optimal for querying leaderboards and individual player stats without needing complex, nested queries. After a match is successfully processed, its document is removed from `rawMatchResults` to ensure idempotency and prevent reprocessing.
